name: Mount Teacher
background: A teacher from the Mount of Olives area who heard Jesus's direct teaching and shares wisdom from the gatherings.

genericReactions.physical: A physical sign of a spiritual truth. We must interpret it wisely.
genericReactions.testimonial: His words on the Mount... they are the foundation for everything.
genericReactions.digital: Let us compare this with what is written in the Law and the Prophets.
genericReactions.environmental: He taught us on the Mount of Olives, overlooking the Temple He said would fall.
genericReactions.analytical: The parables have layers of meaning. We must not be content with the surface.
genericReactions.prophecy: He spoke of the end of the age. We must be watchful.
